method: Deterministic comparison of exact recorded model responses, no Author redraw, model request or campaign write.
evidence_contract: The original after endpoint and prior-source/full-after-slot assessment remain. Endpoint attestation consumes no physical action position.
protection_controls: Recorded v10 contradicted after-slot source remains rejected; only wire-version metadata adapted for replay.
Unknown, forged, missing or misbound source evidence remains rejected.
True reverse action order and typed custody chronology remain rejected.
Policy binding invalidates old approval/reuse; source digest format stays unchanged.
limits: Replay acceptance is not a retroactive action commit or a new successful playthrough.
Source entailment and scope classification remain probabilistic.
Typed state/action chronology has not been relaxed.
